name: app-icon-store-card-and-dynamic-island-integration-board
title: Lime gradient P icon, App Store card and a phone home screen with a Dynamic Island timer
whatItIs: A board with a white panel showing a lime gradient rounded-square 'P' icon, a grey panel with an App Store card (icon, name, GET button), and a black panel with a phone home screen where the icon sits among system apps and the Dynamic Island shows a 4 min countdown with lime dot.
whatItMeans: Thorough and polished; the icon is proven in three real contexts.
techniques: Show the icon big, in a store card and on a home screen.
Integrate a live activity in the Dynamic Island.
Label each panel with an outlined pill.
Use lime gradient on the icon.

vocabulary.definition: iPhone pill area showing live activities.
A real-time status shown on the lock or island.
